message.content:
This vertical rectangular magazine cover features an orange background and a large white "TEMPO" masthead. Above it, a blue bar contains yellow text: "Wawancara dengan Pemenang Nobel Perdamaian". Below the title, small black text reads "EDISI 20-26 Oktober 2003".

The central illustration depicts five caricature-style human figures with oversized heads, fair skin, and light-yellow shirts. They are clumped together, appearing to float or fall diagonally across the frame. Their bodies and limbs are intertwined as they grasp a tall, light-brown, wooden chair-like structure. This structure has a high back with a small circular logo and a seat. The chair is being lifted or tilted upward. 

One figure with a beard and brown hair faces right with an open mouth. Below him, another figure with glasses and a large nose looks down. At the bottom, a fifth figure with glasses looks left. In the bottom left, large black text reads: "Apa yang Kau Cari, Golkar". A barcode with the number "00034" and price "Rp 14.790" are at the bottom right. A dark shadow of a tank barrel is cast at the bottom.
